text:
maya: Quick heads-up — we need a small clarification on the benchmark blog before publish. HN commenters spotted mixing of 95th and p99 in one chart, we should add a short explainer + exact hardware footnote. Embargo is noon PST tomorrow, but this needs to land today.
ryan: I can add a footnote and regenerate the chart SVG. 95th measured with batching=8, p99 with batching=1 — will call that out. ETA ~2h.
olga: Hold outreach until updated post is live. I'll tell press contacts there's a minor clarification coming, no full re-brief. @maya can you confirm the copy? :ear: 
jin: Do we need to update benchmark repo docs too, or just the blog? Let's avoid future confusion.
maya: Both. @ryan push chart + footnote to repo and ping me. olga, hold press pings. jin, open a small PR to repo docs after ryan's changes.
ryan: Suggested footnote: 
```
Note: Latency percentiles reported in the charts mix independently measured 95th and p99 values due to differing sampling windows. 95th values used batching=8; p99 values used batching=1 to capture tail behavior. All runs used instance: A100-40GB, sequence=2048, model=redwood/benchmark-v1.
```
olga: LGTM. Drafting a short note for top-tier outlets: "minor methodology clarification; headline results unchanged."
maya: Timeline: ryan done by +2h (1852105168), maya review +15m after that, push live +30m, olga pings press after live. I'll update embargo sheet.
deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled publish job (marketing/publish) set for 2025-07-22T19:00:00Z paused until manual resume.
ryan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/benchmarks/pull/412 - footnote added + svg regenerated.
maya: Reviewing now. If no blockers I'll greenlight at 1852104668. Thanks. :+1:
olga: Saved press list note in /marketing/embargoes, standing by.
jin: Doc PR queued to add FAQ entry explaining percentiles/batching.
maya: Once live, we'll post pinned update in #general linking to the blog + FAQ.
